title: Arabic word-timing handoff contract (words.json)
description: Output of stage 2 (WhisperX) and the ONLY input for the karaoke caption component and scene boundaries. Times are seconds on audio/clean.wav, i.e. AFTER silence cuts. display keeps tashkeel; align is diacritics-stripped for forced alignment. Extra fields are allowed; downstream stages read only what they need.

audio.description: Relative path to the cleaned audio used for alignment

edits.description: Relative path to the Auto-Editor edit decision list, if silence was cut

source_text.description: Relative path to the reviewed script; the ASR must NOT rewrite it

display.description: Word as shown, WITH tashkeel and original spelling

align.description: Diacritics-stripped form used for wav2vec2 forced alignment

line.description: Index into lines[]; the full shaped line is what gets rendered

bdi.description: Wrap in <bdi> when the word is a number or Latin token inside RTL text

lines.description: Whole shaped lines rendered as one text run; word highlighting happens inside the line

unverified.description: Indices of words whose timing was interpolated; must appear in qa/report.md
